target.statement: Number of significant LISA clusters (55 total: 47 High-High, 8 Low-Low) in the uncorrected local Moran analysis of Colombian malaria incidence, and the ESS-adjusted counts (ESS ≈ 364.5 from APLE ρ̂ = 0.4911)
target.table_ref: Section 6 / Section 2 (Figure 1 and text; no numbered table for the case study)

compute.basis: Data is a small public shapefile (1,066 polygons); the analysis is local Moran + APLE + ESS-adjusted Bonferroni/BH, all cheap on CPU, but no code is released so the agent must reimplement LISA/APLE/ESS from the paper and match the reported counts.

blockers: Must reimplement APLE estimator and ESS formula to match reported ρ̂=0.4911 and ESS=364.5
